brief:
Palestine has announced the establishment of a branch of the International Chamber of Commerce in Ramallah, the Ma'an news agency reported. The development marks a formal step toward integrating Palestinian business institutions into international commercial frameworks and trade governance structures.

The chamber's establishment is expected to facilitate Palestinian participation in global commerce networks and provide a platform for business coordination. The announcement did not specify details about the leadership structure, operational priorities, or timeline for the chapter to begin formal operations in the West Bank city.
title: Palestine launches International Chamber of Commerce chapter in Ramallah
